items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: Me and Willie was an organizer band when he come back from California.

ctx.x: Ask him who they work with.

Say, who did they work with? Different bands. I used to work with them sometimes. I used to work with all three of them sometimes. Different part of the highs, you know. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. I said, I said, man, he comes over after a while. He's dead, too. How about them Jules of Brothers? One of them, two of them, you know, Willie got kicked, you know. Me and Willie was an…
He moved. Tell him he moved. He done moved?
